services.title: Roof Replacement & Repair
services.short_description: Owens Corning Preferred Contractor installs with the longest warranty available — and options for every budget.
services.long_description: Our dedication to customer service means keeping you informed every step of the way, from quote to completion. Beginning with our one-of-a-kind in-home estimate, Eastern takes the time to ensure each customer knows exactly what they're getting for the money. We offer options for every budget and easy financing for the unexpected. As an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, Eastern Residential Solutions can provide you with the longest warranty available — giving you the most roof for your money.

services.title: Storm Damage & Insurance Claims
services.short_description: Hail, wind, or tree damage — we work directly with your insurance company so you don't have to.
services.long_description: When it comes to repairs, we work directly with your insurance company, saving you time and frustration. Whether it's hail, wind, or tree damage, we go the distance to ensure the repair is done to your satisfaction. Our project managers help homeowners navigate claims and make sure the correct amount is issued for the damage — we're paid the same regardless of what your insurer pays, so our only job is making sure you get the reimbursement you deserve. Solutions that are built to last, on time and on budget.

services.title: Siding Installation
services.short_description: Premium vinyl siding from contemporary to classic — low maintenance, high performance, looks that last.
services.long_description: Eastern offers premium vinyl siding in options from contemporary to classic. Our team will help you find the right look and feel for your home, as well as your budget. Additional services such as window replacement, accessories, soffit, and gutter replacement are also available. The Norandex brand of exterior building products provides a low-maintenance, high-performance exterior with looks that last — the Woodsman Select line is popular for the warm, natural look of rough sawn cedar with all the benefits of vinyl.

gallery.alt: Home exterior with new premium vinyl siding
Norandex Woodsman Select siding in a rough sawn cedar look

services.title: Seamless Gutters
services.short_description: Aluminum seamless gutters formed on-site to your home's exact measurements, in dozens of colors.
services.long_description: Eastern installs seamless gutters made from high-quality aluminum coil for a product that is flexible, durable, and designed to protect your home for years to come. Conveniently assembled and installed all on-site, with a variety of colors designed to blend in or stand out, complementing your home's exterior. Seamless and continuous: uniquely made to the exact measurements of your home without any seams, far less prone to leaking and much more visually appealing than sectional gutters. Exceptionally strong: highly durable materials with a rust-inhibiting primer that offers excellent resistance to dents, rust, and harsh weather, and will not become brittle with age.

testimonials.name: Jim B.
testimonials.text: We had a remarkable experience with Eastern Residential Solutions. Our first meeting was with a company representative who did a complete inspection of our roof and afterward sat down with us to discuss the fees and answer any questions. The crew worked quickly and completed the job in 2 days. They left the job site as clean or cleaner than they found it. Would use Eastern again without hesitation.

testimonials.name: Lori T.
testimonials.text: The customer service provided by Eastern is second to none. From the first day you call for services until the day your project is completed you will feel like you are their only customer. Their project managers have no problem helping you navigate through insurance claims and ensuring you are getting a fair deal. Our roof was complete in one day. Eastern's warranty is so comprehensive that they would be out of business if their work was anything less than perfect. Thank you Eastern for giving us peace of mind and a beautiful roof.

testimonials.name: Jo Anne M.
testimonials.text: It went excellent. They are the only company who called back when they said they would and started the work when they said they would. I found them to be extremely reliable and well prepared. They showed up, cleaned up, and did everything perfectly. I would highly recommend them to others.

testimonials.name: Maureen & Ernie
testimonials.text: Thank you for doing such a quality job on our roof replacement. Both you and your associates were very efficient, friendly, and did an excellent job on cleaning up. We will not hesitate to recommend your company to all our friends and neighbors. It was our pleasure to work with you from the very beginning through a completed job!

testimonials.name: Marisa E.
testimonials.text: It was impeccable as well as the workmanship. They were very very prompt, time conscious, super clean and my yard was left very neat.

testimonials.name: Jim B.
testimonials.text: I was very pleased with their service, very efficient and did quality work. They also cleaned up the area, took all the debris away and followed up on any issues that I had.

testimonials.name: Kim J.
testimonials.text: We couldn't be more pleased with our roof installation experience. Eastern was professional, extremely responsive, timely, fast, and organized.

testimonials.name: Brennan & Brennan
testimonials.text: Excellent job done very quickly. From the salesman/job estimator down to the roofers and clean up crews, everyone did a great job.

about.story: Eastern Residential Solutions is a full-service residential contractor specializing in roof repair and replacement, siding installation, and seamless gutters. Whether it's new construction or an existing home in need of improvement, we have the solution to your home's exterior needs. We are a division of Eastern Roofing Systems Inc., one of the largest and most respected commercial roofing companies on the east coast. Located in Jessup, PA and serving Lackawanna, Luzerne, Wayne, Pike, Wyoming, Monroe, and Susquehanna counties, with a Maryland location serving Baltimore City and seventeen Maryland counties.
